description.text: Degree Awarded Students are required to complete the curriculum and course, fulfill the designated number of credits.Successful candidates will receive a graduation certificate along with the bachelor's degree, in accordance to the regulation of the Degree Awarding Committee.

duration.text: The Preventive Medicine at Hainan Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Certificate of HSK HSK level 4 6. Additional materials Additional materials may be required

requirements.text: 1. Applicants should be high school graduates 2. Age of 18 to 35, 3. Healthy, and have English language ability.
